name: add-new-tool
description: Implement a new tool from scratch and wire it into the factory. End-to-end feature addition.
task: Add a 'word_count' tool to Yrden. It should accept a file path, read the file, and return how many words it contains. Study the existing tools in Sources/Yrden/Tools/ to match the conventions, create Sources/Yrden/Tools/WordCountTool.swift, and register it in BuiltInTools.swift so it's included when agents are created.
